scope: 221 historical main BDFs; 211 have mapped nonempty Han. No exact same-Unicode whole/cropped matches. Unmapped slots are not evidence of difference. Historical removed sources are included where available; not all current fonts have full sources.

sampleOnlySupplement.method: Sample-only exact 1-bit cropped-glyph template search in existing public PNGs for same Unicode Han named in each row text. Original HP-UX pixels, no scaling or border padding. Search covers complete target PNG; a match is a contained shape, not independently segmented glyph provenance. Nonmatches cannot establish full-font novelty. Alpha>128 and mean RGB<128 define public ink; reference-only photos excluded.

unchecked.reason: Reference image, not native font specimen

fullSourceGapNote: The previous 45-source gap and mapping limitations remain; sample-only search does not fill it.
